summary: Approved as readable, behavior-validated unmatched C++; zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Control flow, cdecl ABI, 32-bit layouts, callback forwarding, return values and missing-callback behavior agree with the original. Crash preconditions, platform layout and exception limitations are disclosed. Sampled validation does not establish all-input equivalence.
